transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my ankles, really — both of them have swollen up. My shoes have started feeling tight by the afternoon.
When did you first notice it?
Oh, it's been a while back now. I can't quite put a date on it.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Yes — it's always worse by the evening, and by the morning it's mostly gone again once I've been lying flat.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a bit puffy and tight, mostly just uncomfortable rather than painful. Socks leave marks on my skin by the end of the day.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's both ankles, and up the lower shins a bit — about the same on each side. It doesn't seem to go anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
Oh, it's not too bad really — more of a nuisance than anything.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It comes and goes during the day, if that makes sense.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, not really — I haven't had any breathlessness lying flat or in the night, and no chest pain. My legs aren't sore or red either.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I've got high blood pressure, and they've told me my kidney function is a bit reduced. I see the doctor for those.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I take some tablets for my blood pressure, a small water tablet in the mornings, and a statin at night.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I don't have any allergies to medicines as far as I know.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I've taken to sitting with my feet up in the afternoons, and I've stopped wearing my usual shoes because they don't fit.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Well, I do worry a bit — my sister had heart failure, and I'm frightened this swelling means the same thing is happening to me.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
